runtime_path.description: Root directory for runtime data (logs, IPC sockets, temporary files). Ensure the path exists and is writable by the service user.

ipc_socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket used for client-server communication. Must be unique per Monado instance to avoid conflicts.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Accepts DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, or FATAL.

verbose_logging.description: Enable additional low-level logging for troubleshooting. Use only when debugging.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for background processing (e.g., event handling, buffering). Increase for high-throughput or multi-device setups.

type.description: Device class (e.g., 'openxr', 'keyboard', 'gamepad'). Must match a supported device driver.

enabled.description: Whether this device is active and polled for input.

config.description: Device-specific settings (e.g., timeout, key mapping). Keys and values depend on the device type.

input_devices.description: List of input devices to integrate with Monado. Each device may have its own configuration.

name.description: Unique name for the layer (used for debugging and layer management).

enabled.description: Whether to render this layer during composition.

type.description: Layer kind (e.g., 'overlay', 'quad', 'cylinder'). Must be supported by the compositor backend.

options.description: Layer-specific rendering options (e.g., opacity, position, content source).

compositor_layers.description: Post-processing or overlay layers added to the final composited image. Useful for debugging or HUDs.

enabled.description: Whether the backend is loaded at runtime.

path.description: Absolute path to the shared library implementing the backend (optional if installed system-wide).

config.description: Backend-specific settings (e.g., refresh rate, render resolution).

backends.description: List of OpenXR backend plugins to load. Each backend supports a specific runtime (e.g., Oculus, SteamVR, or software fallback).
